description: This file defines a React component 'MarkdownView' that renders Markdown-formatted text as HTML using a custom simple parser. It supports headers, bold, italics, inline code, and basic paragraphs, intended for lightweight markdown rendering within a React project.

methods.name: simpleMarkdownToHtml
methods.description: Converts a markdown string into an HTML string with basic formatting support for headers, bold, italics, inline code, and paragraphs.
